disks.title: Omega Document Disk (DOCS)
disks.description: Prepared empty Omega document disk (150 free pages) ready for saving and recalling documents in Drive B:.

disks.title: Blank Formatted Disk
disks.description: Low-level formatted disk (data only on track 0). Use Omega COMMAND P D to prepare it as a document disk.

disks.title: Compucorp 665 Hardware Diagnostics
disks.description: Standalone bare-metal hardware diagnostic suite testing RAM, paged memory boards, video, keyboard, CTC/mains, floppy, and SIO B.

disks.title: ROM-Switch Hardware Probe
disks.description: Tests candidate output ports (port 74h, PIO B spare pins, SIO B lines) to see if any unmap the boot ROM. Enable ROM-off switch in Settings to see port 74h react.
